gloss: to grow cold, to get chilly

definitions.gloss: to grow cold, to cool down
definitions.explanation: For something or someone to become cold. The intransitive form.

definitions.gloss: to feel cold, to get chilled
definitions.explanation: For the body to feel cold or become chilled.

examples.japanese: ビールが{冷|ひ}えている。
{体|からだ}が{冷|ひ}えてしまった。
{足|あし}が{冷|ひ}えないように{靴下|くつした}を{履|は}いた。
examples.english: I put on socks so my feet wouldn't get cold.

examples.japanese: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}に{入|い}れておいた{飲|の}み{物|もの}がよく{冷|ひ}えていて{美味|おい}しかった。
examples.english: The drinks I had put in the refrigerator were nicely chilled and delicious.

examples.japanese: {空気|くうき}が{冷|ひ}えてきた。
{お腹|おなか}が{冷|ひ}えないように{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful not to let your stomach get cold.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}に{濡|ぬ}れて{体|からだ}が{冷|ひ}えた。
examples.english: I got wet in the rain and my body got chilled.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {冷|ひ}やす (transitive, to cool something). Pattern: Xが{冷|ひ}える (X gets cold).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {冷|ひ}えている = 'is cold' (state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ビールが{冷|ひ}えている (beer is cold)
・{体|からだ}が{冷|ひ}える (body gets cold)
・{足|あし}が{冷|ひ}える (feet get cold)
・{冷|ひ}え{性|しょう} (sensitivity to cold—noun)
・{底冷|そこび}え (deep chill)

CONTRAST:
・{冷|ひ}える (intransitive): X gets cold
・{冷|ひ}やす (transitive): cool X down

SIMILAR VERBS:
・{冷|さ}める: to cool down (food/drinks), to lose enthusiasm
・{冷|ひ}える: to get cold (body, atmosphere)
